name: emojisense-search
title: Emojisense
description: Search emoji by meaning, slang and intent: "ship it" → 🚀, "lgtm" → 👍. Works offline.
author: emojisense

commands.name: search-emoji
commands.title: Search Emoji
commands.subtitle: Emojisense
commands.description: Find emoji by meaning, slang or intent, then copy or paste them.

preferences.name: locale
preferences.title: Language
preferences.description: Language for labels and for ranking. Both languages are always searched.

preferences.name: primaryAction
preferences.title: Primary Action
preferences.description: What Enter does with the selected emoji.

preferences.name: apiUrl
preferences.title: API URL
preferences.description: Optional. Adds semantic results from the Emojisense API for unsure queries.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Optional. Your secret key (sk_live_…) or publishable key (pk_live_…).

scripts.build: tsx scripts/bundle-packs.mts && ray build -e dist -o dist --non-interactive
